contamination_risks: The 2016-2020 partition is already outcome exposed and is training only.
The adverse 2023-2025 predecessor cannot promote this version.
No 2021-2022 confirmation row may enter selection.
family_contract.entry_rule: At each completed SPY close in the frozen one- or three-session window before month end or after month start, require close above the frozen completed SMA and ATR14/close at least five times primary round-trip cost; enter at the next session open.
family_contract.exit_rule: Resolve the stop first on daily ambiguity and otherwise exit at the completed close after two or four sessions.
family_contract.expected_holding_behavior: Long only, next-session-open entry, and flat within four sessions.
family_contract.material_difference_rationale: This version preserves the calendar-seasonality mechanism while replacing one low-capacity monthly timing choice with a frozen family of month-boundary windows, trend gates, stops, and holds on wholly disjoint dates under family-wise controls.
family_contract.mechanism: Own SPY during a prospectively frozen set of sessions surrounding the month boundary when the completed long-term trend is positive and ordinary movement is large enough to clear modeled costs.

predecessor.adverse_finding: The exact second-to-last-session SPY v1 rule lost 4.65R at primary cost across 36 monthly entries.

family_contract.primary_outcome: Selection-adjusted chronological account log growth after costs.
production_compatibility_risks: The current XNYS calendar, complete SPY history, next-open quote, spread, depth, halt, tradability, timestamp, protection, and reconciliation remain mandatory.
family_contract.ranking_rule: SPY is the sole frozen instrument; at most one family entry occurs per session and portfolio contention remains authoritative.
family_contract.selection_rule: Portfolio risk, concurrent-position, aggregate-risk, daily-entry, gross-notional, and capital-contention caps remain authoritative.
family_contract.stop_rule: Place the exact 1.0 or 1.5 ATR14 stop below the next open; invalid or missing stops and bars produce rejected or missed trades.
